What is a rogue DHCP server?
An unauthorized DHCP server that hands out incorrect or malicious network settings
Which incorrect settings might a rogue DHCP server provide?
A false default gateway or malicious DNS server
Which switch feature BEST prevents rogue DHCP servers?
How does DHCP snooping distinguish legitimate DHCP servers?
Server replies are allowed only on trusted ports
Which port should be configured as trusted for DHCP snooping?
The uplink toward the legitimate DHCP server
Which symptom suggests a rogue DHCP server is active?
Clients receive addresses from an unexpected subnet or wrong gateway
Which binding information does DHCP snooping record for connected clients?
IP address, MAC address, port, and VLAN
What is a rogue access point?
An unauthorized wireless AP connected to the network
Which risk does a rogue AP connected to the wired network create?
An unauthorized, often unsecured path into the internal network
Which tool helps detect rogue access points?
A wireless intrusion detection system (WIDS) or wireless controller scanning
Which wired-side control helps prevent unauthorized APs from connecting?
Which practice helps identify rogue APs during a wireless survey?
Comparing detected BSSIDs to an authorized device inventory
Which statement about an employee-installed consumer AP is TRUE?
Even well-intentioned rogue APs can weaken security if unmanaged
Which feature can a wireless controller use to contain a confirmed rogue AP, where legally permitted?
Sending deauthentication frames to clients of the rogue
Which security goal is MOST threatened by a rogue AP offering open access?
Which control helps detect a rogue DHCP server quickly across a campus?
Centralized DHCP snooping logs and alerts
Which statement about DHCP snooping and client trust is TRUE?
Client-facing ports are untrusted so they cannot offer DHCP leases
Which rogue service could be used to capture credentials by mimicking a login portal?
A rogue captive portal or fake authentication service
Which practice reduces the chance users connect to a rogue service?
User awareness and validating certificates before entering credentials
Which statement about rogue devices and physical security is TRUE?
Securing network jacks and closets reduces opportunities to connect rogue devices
Which control pairs with DHCP snooping to block spoofed source IPs on access ports?
Which statement about rogue AP detection and SSIDs is TRUE?
A rogue may broadcast a familiar SSID, so detection should rely on BSSID and wired checks
Which action should follow discovery of a rogue AP plugged into a switch?
Locate the switch port, disable it, and remove the device
Which log helps locate the switch port of a rogue device by MAC address?
Which statement about NAC and rogue devices is TRUE?
NAC can deny or quarantine devices that fail authentication or posture checks
Which practice helps prevent rogue DHCP on wireless guest networks?
Isolating guests and blocking client-run DHCP services
Which statement about rogue AP risk on a flat network is TRUE?
A rogue AP provides broad access because there is little segmentation
Rogue APs can't work on flat networks
Which monitoring approach detects unauthorized DHCP offers?
Which statement about disabling unused switch ports and rogue devices is TRUE?
Disabled ports prevent attaching rogue devices to open jacks
Which rogue device could redirect clients by advertising itself as the default gateway via DHCP?
Which statement about rogue AP containment and regulations is TRUE?
Deauthentication-based containment may be restricted by law and should be used carefully
Which practice helps distinguish an authorized AP from a rogue during audits?
Maintaining an inventory of authorized APs and their BSSIDs
Which statement about rogue services and segmentation is TRUE?
Segmentation limits how far a rogue service's influence spreads
Which control helps ensure only the legitimate DHCP server responds in a VLAN?
DHCP snooping with a single trusted uplink
Which statement about rogue AP detection timing is TRUE?
Continuous wireless scanning detects rogues faster than periodic manual checks
Which statement about rogue devices and 802.1X is TRUE?
802.1X blocks unauthenticated devices from the wired network
Which action helps verify a suspected rogue DHCP server's location?
Tracing the offending server's MAC through switch tables to a port
Which statement about guest networks and rogue APs is TRUE?
Guests should be isolated so a rogue AP there cannot reach internal systems
Which practice reduces the chance of an unauthorized AP being added undetected?
Port authentication, monitoring, and physical security together
Which statement about rogue DHCP impact is TRUE?
It can cause connectivity loss or redirect traffic depending on the settings it pushes
Which control would alert administrators when a new wireless BSSID appears on the premises?
Which statement about rogue services and credential theft is TRUE?
Fake login services can collect credentials from unwary users
Which first response is appropriate after confirming a rogue DHCP server?
Disable the offending port and ensure DHCP snooping is enforced
Which statement about rogue AP risk and encryption is TRUE?
A rogue AP with open or weak security exposes connected clients' traffic
Which practice helps employees avoid connecting personal APs to the corporate network?
Clear acceptable use policies and enforcement via NAC
Which statement about DHCP snooping deployment is TRUE?
It should be enabled per VLAN with correct trusted ports defined
All ports are trusted by default appropriately
Which detective control would reveal a rogue AP bridging Wi-Fi to the wired LAN?
Correlating wireless scans with wired MAC and port data
Which statement about rogue devices and network documentation is TRUE?
An accurate asset inventory makes unauthorized devices easier to spot
Which BEST summarizes defenses against rogue DHCP and APs?
Use DHCP snooping, 802.1X, wireless intrusion detection, segmentation, physical security, and asset inventory
Which practice helps an organization keep an up-to-date picture of authorized wireless access points?
Maintaining and regularly reviewing an authorized AP inventory
